statement: The recorded travel of plus 15 millimetres is not safe for this case, as the stage collides with the detector housing at plus 8 millimetres; I will run the scan using plus 5 millimetres instead.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The recorded travel of plus 15 millimetres is not safe... stage collides with the detector housing at plus 8 millimetres" directly asserts the record's limit is wrong and gives a corrected value.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
